properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.yaml, inference.rs concession_of). A CONTRADICTS from a reply to an objection with `alignment: conceding` and `moves_to` (node_ref) grants the objection: while the reply holds, the objection counts against its target as if it held (`standing: conceded`, `conceded_by`, `moves_to`); a conceded step reads `objected: conceded` and supports nothing, so the claim stands on the reading moved to; the reply reads `concedes`, the objection `conceded`. heal and the report treat a concession as no conflict.
properties.name: A reply concedes an objection against one reading and moves the argument to another (CONTRADICTS alignment conceding, moves_to)
